svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Ensemble learning framework
svg.desc: A left-ventriculography X-ray frame feeds 16 base models (U-Net and ResNet, each trained with 8 loss functions). U-Net with Binary Lovász collapsed and is excluded; the 15 remaining members are fused by six rules. Consensus voting reaches Dice 0.9585.
